pose: Full body side profile in a 1:1 square frame. A sleek, medium-sized Albertosaurus with a slightly slender build compared to a T-Rex. It is standing with one foot slightly forward, tilting its head curiously at a bright blue butterfly hovering near its snout. It has small, decorative crests above its eyes and soulful, friendly eyes. The skin has a subtle leathery texture with soft, downy feathers along the spine. A gentle smirk is visible on its snout. Standard three-toed theropod feet on the ground with blunt, toy-like nails. Cinematic forest lighting.
